name: cufe-study-guide
description: Author intuition-first university lecture study guides with source coverage, practice, conceptual breaks, quizzes, and shared-model DOCX/direct PDF rendering.

interface.shortDescription: Intuition-first lecture study guides and revision
interface.longDescription: Transform supplied university lectures into coherent learning guides using concept planning, source coverage, progressive examples, practice, relevant prior connections, study breaks, and quizzes with reasoned answers. The baseline creates DOCX and direct PDF from one validated semantic model using a restrained visual system. Validated on one real CUFE lecture plus public mechanical and behavior regressions; additional courses can be added as private validation cases.
